pillar_reactions.evidence: The call was terminated and rebooked after about nine minutes, before any part of the methodology was delivered.

Not delivered. Nutrition was the prospect's own leading ask — 'dietary structure would be nice' — and he raised an open question about whether eating one meal a day is harming him, which was noted but not answered.

unmet_demand.want: A short, low-commitment conversation producing a basic plan. This was the expectation he arrived with and he stated it twice: 'earlier when I talked to the last guy, he had said that this was like a 10 or 15 minute conversation' and 'he was saying that it was just a short call, ask questions, and get a basic plan set up.'
unmet_demand.why_unmet: There is no product or interaction that matches what was described to him. The actual offering is a booked hour of discovery leading to a $6,000 six-month commitment. The gap here is at the top of the funnel rather than in the product — the expectation was set by the setter, not by anything the prospect assumed — and the rep to his credit did not try to bridge it in the moment, rebooking instead and undertaking to check what had been said.

unmet_demand.want: A straight answer on whether eating roughly one meal a day is harming him. He put it as an open question — 'my father has been a very big proponent saying that that's actually hurting me... you're slowing down your metabolism, and yeah, honestly, I don't know the truth of it.'
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Not answered, which is reasonable given the call was being wound up, but it is the clearest stated need in the file and the one thing he named unprompted as something he wants resolved. Recorded so it is not lost before the rebooked call.

unmet_demand.want: Programming structure and new movement complexes — 'trying to get a plan in place, like an actual plan for hitting new groups, muscle groups' and 'having more guidance towards what to do to kind of spread things out. New ideas.'
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Not reached. Recorded because the shape of the ask is worth noting for the rebooked call: what he described wanting is programming and variety rather than transformation or accountability, which is closer to a template or lower-tier product than to six months of one-to-one coaching. Whether the flagship is the right fit is genuinely open on this evidence.
